test_case.test_name: AMD RCD/DRAM parity UCE with immediate reset and BERT
test_case.purpose: For each approved RCD/DIMM target, inject the documented parity UCE, verify the designed immediate warm reset and correlate a persistent post-boot BERT/CPER record to that target.
required_package: AMD flag-to-UCE authority for dramothererrors errortype0/errormode0
Vendor-correct CLI and per-slot RCD/UMC selector map
Exact reset, firmware boot and OS-ready deadlines
OOB recovery, injector cleanup and BIOS/HDT restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not execute. Once severity mapping is documented, stage durable pre-state and continuous OOB capture, inject one mapped target, time dispatch-to-reset-to-boot, decode the post-boot BERT/CPER to the same source/location, verify memory health, disable injection and restore before any separately authorized target.
test_case.expected_result: The approved parity UCE causes the specified immediate reset, the SUT boots within all deadlines, BERT/CPER precisely identifies the target/severity and no residual parity/injector state remains.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS exists until the flags are proven to select UCE. A correctable event, arbitrary reset, unmatched BERT record, boot timeout or generic log cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with OOB power/reimage and verified boot media.
No injection until severity, target and recovery deadlines are signed.
One target only; abort on wrong severity/location, missing reset, boot loop or lost console.
No automatic reset, retry or next-target execution.
expected_evidence: Versioned flag mapping and corrected CLI
Per-slot RCD/UMC map and BIOS/HDT pre-state
Full dispatch and OOB reset/boot timeline
Decoded matching BERT/CPER plus BMC/UEFI evidence
Post-boot memory health, cleanup, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: The platform owner must define authorized reset/power/reimage branches, injector cleanup and post-boot health gates. Execution stays blocked until recovery is matched to the proven UCE mode.
